verdict.rationale: Core gateway operations are API-driven: inference through a unified, OpenAI-compatible API, provider routing, failover and caching set per request via providerOptions.gateway, per-request BYOK credentials, and an unauthenticated models/pricing endpoint. A Vercel OpenAPI spec and a CLI command for coding-agent setup also exist. However, several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent: the logs page (search, filter, CSV/JSON export), usage and spend dashboards, and budget configuration. missing for 10: documented API access to request logs and usage/spend metrics, API-based budget and API-key management, evidence that the OpenAPI spec covers AI Gateway admin endpoints, independent confirmation of UI/API parity.
